text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in Norwegian papers this morning:

- Local governments need between 15 and 20 billion crowns altogether to make roads around schools safer for students. In 1995, 329 children were injured or killed in traffic on their way to and from school.

- The two Nobel Peace prize winners, Bishop Carlos Belo and resistance leader Jose Ramos-Horta, have arrived for Tuesday's prize ceremony in Oslo's City Hall. Bishop Belo said Mass in St. Olav's church in Oslo on Sunday.

- Norway and Venezuela have suggested that an independent, global energy organisation be formed. Energy Minister Grete Faremo said at an international energy conference in India that there is no energy organisation today that could formulate an overall energy policy.
- Mail order sales are estimated to increase by four percent this year. This is more than the increase in retail sale. In 1997 mail order sales are expected to increase by six percent.
